title: ListIdentity discovery request
purpose: Exercise the canonical EtherNet/IP discovery command with a complete encapsulation header and no nested payload assumptions.
expected_behavior: The server parses the ListIdentity command and may return a List Identity Response Item; ordinary unsupported-command or transport behavior is acceptable when discovery is unavailable.
constraints_preserved: Payload length is zero and matches the transmitted body
Session handle and status are zero for the discovery request
issue_safety_notes: Safe discovery analogue with no session-handle reuse, no forged identity data, and no malformed or oversized fields.
